The DOI locator field points to the paper 10.1038/sdata.2016.80. Notes assert programmatic extraction, per-material database identifiers, facet indices and rounding. Those remain archive provenance declarations, not this review verifying the dataset or the extraction.

Ag/Au/Pt surface_energy_110 and Sr surface_energy_111 notes explicitly call the selected dataset termination reconstructed. Preserve those four location caveats across their existing model edges. Missing such a note elsewhere is not evidence of compatible ideal termination or successful convergence.

Ca notes add a phase-stability/ambient-structure assertion with an energetic example. The example was exposed, but neither it nor the claim was independently checked and neither is used to select records.

The nine DFT-PBE entries cite Angsten et al., New Journal of Physics, Table A.1, DOI 10.1088/1367-2630/16/1/015018, with VASP 5.2.2 and PBE-GGA stated in the citation. Notes claim an earlier article extraction. This is an archived-calculation declaration, not new DFT, a new primary-source check or verification of calculation equivalence.
